name: 낡은 석판
pages: 쇠뇌 회랑. 갑각 무리가 지키던 길이다.
받아친 화살을 되돌려 보낼 수 있었다고 한다.
pages_en: The Crossbow Gallery. The shell-folk once held this road.
Bolts flash white before they fly.
Dodge them, or parry them out of the air.
It is said that whoever bested the captain at the gallery's end
could send parried bolts flying back.
